metadata.title: Mid-Century Cheerleader Action Cover
useCases: Album art for surf rock or 60s pop

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1960s aesthetic featuring subjects in mid-air against a solid sky background with bold, heavy slab-serif typography in the upper third.
triggerTerms: retro action photography with slab serif
excludeWhen: modern high-definition sports photography is required
dark or moody lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Three cheerleaders in vintage white sweaters and blue skirts are captured in a synchronized mid-air jump against a clear, vibrant blue sky. The composition is anchored by heavy, yellow slab-serif text at the top, creating a tri-color palette of blue, yellow, and white.
coreVisualRelationships: Yellow typography matches the yellow pom-poms for color rhythm
Subject placement in the lower two-thirds balances the heavy text above
Diagonal body lines of the jumpers create dynamic upward movement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three human figures centered horizontally, occupying the lower 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Bold yellow display text in the top 25% of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left text, moves across the title, then drops to the dynamic diagonal limbs of the central jumpers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open blue sky surrounding the subjects to emphasize the height of the jump.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for typography and pom-poms
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white for sweaters and socks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with bright, even daylighting; minimal shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with rectangular serifs and consistent stroke weight
letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point is oversized and integrated into the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, geometric slab serifs and wide stance.
Provides the appropriate mid-century editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of three 1960s-style cheerleaders in white sweaters and blue skirts jumping in the air against a clear blue sky, holding yellow pom-poms.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of heavy, bright yellow slab-serif text in the top left corner, ensuring the text is large and blocky.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a solid, vibrant blue?
Are the serifs on the text thick and rectangular?
Is the text color a bright, matching yellow to the pom-poms?

adjustableVariables: Shade of blue in the sky
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos or small corner text
Exact phrasing of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the jumpers are not overlapping the text
Ensure the yellow of the text is highly legible against the blue
Verify the vintage 1960s clothing style is maintained
Confirm the slab serifs are blocky and not rounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Action subject in lower two-thirds + Solid primary color background + Heavy slab-serif header in contrasting primary color.
